scope: All app/**/*.php blobs read from authenticated GitHub source API, one named PHP type per file. Static import declarations; not a runtime call graph.
limitations: Only App namespace imports included; external framework/vendor imports excluded.
Regex-based source scanner independent of and not identical to PHP tokenizer; native PHP generator not run.
Unqualified ::class hints can be ambiguous aliases/comments and are NOT interpreted as verified dependencies.
No PostgreSQL catalog or dynamic Laravel bindings.
